cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
cards.old_note: *I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for mine holy name's sake* — the Yah who saves in Matt 1:21 saves for his own name's sake; the gospel is name-grace, not merit-grace.
cards.note: Ezekiel 36:22 — *Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) The angel says Yahusha (Jesus) will save *his people*, and Ezekiel shows who they are and why he does it. They are the house of Yashar'el (Israel) that went off among the heathen, and Yahuah (the LORD) says he acts *for mine holy name’s sake*. The saving rests on his name and his word, not on anything they had earned.
cards.prose: The angel says Yahusha (Jesus) will save *his people*, and Ezekiel shows who they are and why he does it. They are the house of Yashar'el (Israel) that went off among the heathen, and Yahuah (the LORD) says he acts *for mine holy name’s sake*. The saving rests on his name and his word, not on anything they had earned.
cards.member_note: Ezekiel 36:22 — *I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for mine holy name’s sake.* Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) tells the scattered house that he will act for his holy name's sake, not for theirs.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
cards.old_note: *Not for thy righteousness ... but ... that he may perform the word which Yahuah (the LORD) sware unto thy fathers* — the prior-promise structure that the Messiah's name announces is now being kept.
cards.note: Deuteronomy 9:5 — *Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) Moses tells the people plainly that the land does not come to them because of their own goodness. It comes because Yahuah (the LORD) is going to *perform the word which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto thy fathers*. The child named Yahusha (Jesus), Yahuah (the LORD) saves, is that same oath being kept for the sons of those fathers.
cards.prose: Moses tells the people plainly that the land does not come to them because of their own goodness. It comes because Yahuah (the LORD) is going to *perform the word which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto thy fathers*. The child named Yahusha (Jesus), Yahuah (the LORD) saves, is that same oath being kept for the sons of those fathers.
cards.member_note: Deuteronomy 9:5 — *Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land.* The saving rests on the oath sworn to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, not on the goodness of the people who receive it.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.old_note: *His people* in 1:21 is locked by 15:24's *the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — same mission scope at the front door of the gospel as at the Canaanite-woman pericope.
cards.note: Matthew 15:24 — *But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) The angel's *his people* is not left vague. Yahusha (Jesus) says who he was sent to when he answers that he is sent only to *the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)*. The one named at his birth for saving his people keeps to that same errand at the end of his teaching.
cards.prose: The angel's *his people* is not left vague. Yahusha (Jesus) says who he was sent to when he answers that he is sent only to *the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)*. The one named at his birth for saving his people keeps to that same errand at the end of his teaching.
cards.member_note: Matthew 15:24 — *But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* Yahusha (Jesus) himself says he is sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), the same people the angel names.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
cards.old_note: Yahusha's (Jesus's) own missionary instruction to the twelve names the same scope as v.21's *his people.*
cards.note: Matthew 10:5 — *These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) When Yahusha (Jesus) sends the twelve out, he sets the bounds of their errand himself, and the bounds are the same as the angel's *his people*. The one who was named at his birth for saving his people is the one who draws the road for the men he sends.
cards.prose: When Yahusha (Jesus) sends the twelve out, he sets the bounds of their errand himself, and the bounds are the same as the angel's *his people*. The one who was named at his birth for saving his people is the one who draws the road for the men he sends.
cards.member_note: Matthew 10:5 — *These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles.* Yahusha (Jesus) sends the twelve first to his own people, which is the scope the angel gave at his birth.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
cards.old_note: Yahuah (the LORD) as the shepherd who himself goes out to seek the lost — Yahusha (Jesus) as the *Yah saves* of v.21 is the Ezek 34 shepherd in flesh.
cards.note: Ezekiel 34:11 — *For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) Ezekiel has Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) say that he himself will *search my sheep, and seek them out*. The angel names the child Yahusha (Jesus), Yahuah (the LORD) saves, and the child is that same shepherd come in the flesh, sent to seek out the people he is saving.
cards.prose: Ezekiel has Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) say that he himself will *search my sheep, and seek them out*. The angel names the child Yahusha (Jesus), Yahuah (the LORD) saves, and the child is that same shepherd come in the flesh, sent to seek out the people he is saving.
cards.member_note: Ezekiel 34:11 — *For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.* Yahuah (the LORD) says he himself will search for his scattered sheep, which is the work Yahusha (Jesus) comes to do.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
cards.old_note: *My sheep hear my voice* — the hearing is the revealing of who *his people* are; the proclamation is broad, the audience is the scattered citizens.
cards.note: John 10:27 — *My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) Who are *his people*? Yahusha (Jesus) answers in his own words, *My sheep hear my voice*. The hearing shows who they were all along. The word goes out wide because the sheep are scattered, and nobody can pick them out by sight.
cards.prose: Who are *his people*? Yahusha (Jesus) answers in his own words, *My sheep hear my voice*. The hearing shows who they were all along. The word goes out wide because the sheep are scattered, and nobody can pick them out by sight.
cards.member_note: John 10:27 — *My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:* Yahusha (Jesus) says his sheep hear his voice, so the hearing shows who his people are.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
cards.old_note: The post-resurrection broadcast through the nations does not abolish the first-mission scope; it disperses the proclamation to where the scattered sheep are.
cards.note: Matthew 28:19 — *Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) The last words of the book send his men to *all nations*, and that does not undo the errand the angel gave at the start. The saving is still for *his people*, and the word goes out among the nations because that is where the scattered sheep now are.
cards.prose: The last words of the book send his men to *all nations*, and that does not undo the errand the angel gave at the start. The saving is still for *his people*, and the word goes out among the nations because that is where the scattered sheep now are.
cards.member_note: Matthew 28:19 — *Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).* The word is sent out among all nations after the resurrection, to reach the scattered sheep wherever they were driven.

cards.src_text: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
cards.tgt_text: And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
cards.old_note: *She hath been more righteous than I* — Tamar's case preserves the kingship-tribe line through Yahudah's (Judah's) own failure to honor levirate.
cards.note: Genesis 38:26 — *And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.* *And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;* (Matthew 1:3) Matthew puts Thamar in the line, and Yahudah's (Judah's) own words explain why she belongs there. He admits *She hath been more righteous than I*, because he had held back his son Shelah from her. The kingly line came through his failure and her claim on him, not around them.
cards.prose: Matthew puts Thamar in the line, and Yahudah's (Judah's) own words explain why she belongs there. He admits *She hath been more righteous than I*, because he had held back his son Shelah from her. The kingly line came through his failure and her claim on him, not around them.
cards.member_note: Genesis 38:26 — *And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son.* Yahudah (Judah) admits Tamar was more righteous than he, so the line of the king comes through his own failure and her claim.

cards.src_text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
cards.tgt_text: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
cards.old_note: Rachab's confession of Yahuah (the LORD) as *Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath* — the specific Yah-ordained grafting in her own life.
cards.note: Joshua 2:11 — *And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath.* *And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;* (Matthew 1:5) Rachab says of Yahuah (the LORD) that *he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath*. Matthew then names her as the mother of Booz by Salmon, a man of Yahudah (Judah). She came into the line by marrying one of the sons of Yashar'el (Israel), and her confession is where that road began.
cards.prose: Rachab says of Yahuah (the LORD) that *he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath*. Matthew then names her as the mother of Booz by Salmon, a man of Yahudah (Judah). She came into the line by marrying one of the sons of Yashar'el (Israel), and her confession is where that road began.
cards.member_note: Joshua 2:11 — *for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath.* Rachab confesses Yahuah (the LORD) as Elohim (God) in heaven and earth, before she marries Salmon and enters the line.

cards.src_text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
cards.tgt_text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy Elohim (God) my Elohim (God):
cards.old_note: *Thy people shall be my people, and thy Elohim (God) my Elohim (God)* — Ruth's specific Yah-ordained transfer from the Moavite peripheral-Avrahamic branch into the Yashar'eli (Israelite) covenant body.
cards.note: Ruth 1:16 — *And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy Elohim (God) my Elohim (God):* *And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;* (Matthew 1:5) Ruth ties herself to Naomi and to Naomi's Elohim (God) with *thy people shall be my people*. Matthew names her as the mother of Obed because she then married Booz, a son of Yashar'el (Israel), and the two became one. Her words were the start, and the marriage is what made her one of the people.
cards.prose: Ruth ties herself to Naomi and to Naomi's Elohim (God) with *thy people shall be my people*. Matthew names her as the mother of Obed because she then married Booz, a son of Yashar'el (Israel), and the two became one. Her words were the start, and the marriage is what made her one of the people.
cards.member_note: Ruth 1:16 — *thy people shall be my people, and thy Elohim (God) my Elohim (God).* Ruth binds herself to Naomi's people and Naomi's Elohim (God), and her marriage to Booz brings her into the line.

cards.src_text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
cards.tgt_text: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
cards.old_note: Moav (Moab) as the son of Lot, Avraham's (Abraham's) nephew — locating Ruth's lineage on the peripheral-Avrahamic branch, not in the unrelated nations.
cards.note: Genesis 19:36 — *Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.* *And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;* (Matthew 1:5) Ruth was a Moabitess, and Moab was born of Lot's daughters. Lot was Abraham's nephew, which puts her people close kin to Abraham's house and not strangers from far away. Even so, what brought her into the line was her marriage to Booz.
cards.prose: Ruth was a Moabitess, and Moab was born of Lot's daughters. Lot was Abraham's nephew, which puts her people close kin to Abraham's house and not strangers from far away. Even so, what brought her into the line was her marriage to Booz.
cards.member_note: Genesis 19:36 — *Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.* Moab came from Lot, Abraham's nephew, so Ruth's people were near kin to Abraham's house.

cards.src_text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
cards.tgt_text: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.old_note: Boaz as kinsman-redeemer — the Tanakh-prefiguring of Yahusha (Jesus) as the kinsman-redeemer of the scattered seed.
cards.note: Ruth 4:14 — *And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Yashar'el (Israel).* *And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;* (Matthew 1:5) The women bless Yahuah (the LORD) for a kinsman who would see to it that *his name may be famous in Yashar'el (Israel)*. Booz stepped in as the kinsman who buys back what was lost, and in Matthew's list he points ahead to Yahusha (Jesus), the kinsman of the scattered house.
cards.prose: The women bless Yahuah (the LORD) for a kinsman who would see to it that *his name may be famous in Yashar'el (Israel)*. Booz stepped in as the kinsman who buys back what was lost, and in Matthew's list he points ahead to Yahusha (Jesus), the kinsman of the scattered house.
cards.member_note: Ruth 4:14 — *Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Yashar'el (Israel).* Booz is the kinsman who redeems Naomi's house, and he points ahead to Yahusha (Jesus) as the kinsman of the scattered house.

cards.src_text: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
cards.tgt_text: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahuah (LORD).
cards.old_note: *The thing that David had done displeased Yahuah (the LORD)* — Matthew's naming of Bathsheba as *her of Uriah* refuses to whitewash the sin in the kingship line.
cards.note: 2 Samuel 11:27 — *And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahuah (LORD).* *And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;* (Matthew 1:6) Matthew could have left her out, or called her by name, and he writes *her that had been the wife of Urias*. That keeps Uriah in view. Samuel's own account says *the thing that David had done displeased Yahuah (LORD)*, so the line to the king is not scrubbed clean.
cards.prose: Matthew could have left her out, or called her by name, and he writes *her that had been the wife of Urias*. That keeps Uriah in view. Samuel's own account says *the thing that David had done displeased Yahuah (LORD)*, so the line to the king is not scrubbed clean.
cards.member_note: 2 Samuel 11:27 — *But the thing that David had done displeased Yahuah (LORD).* Samuel says David's deed displeased Yahuah (the LORD), which is why Matthew names Solomon's mother by her first husband.

cards.src_text: The book of the generation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the son of David, the son of Abraham.
cards.tgt_text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
cards.old_note: *In thee shall all families of the earth be blessed* — the Avrahamic seed-promise the genealogy traces to the Messiah.
cards.note: Genesis 12:3 — *And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.* *The book of the generation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the son of David, the son of Abraham.* (Matthew 1:1) Matthew calls him *the son of Abraham*, and here is the promise made to Abraham. Yahuah (the LORD) said that *in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed*. The long list that follows is the road that promise travelled, from Abraham down to Yahusha (Jesus).
cards.prose: Matthew calls him *the son of Abraham*, and here is the promise made to Abraham. Yahuah (the LORD) said that *in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed*. The long list that follows is the road that promise travelled, from Abraham down to Yahusha (Jesus).
cards.member_note: Genesis 12:3 — *And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.* The promise to Abraham that all families of the earth be blessed in him is what the genealogy carries down to Yahusha (Jesus).

cards.src_text: The book of the generation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the son of David, the son of Abraham.
cards.tgt_text: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
cards.old_note: *I will set up thy seed after thee ... and I will establish the throne of his kingdom for ever* — the Davidic kingship promise the genealogy traces to the Messiah.
cards.note: 2 Samuel 7:12 — *And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.* *The book of the generation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the son of David, the son of Abraham.* (Matthew 1:1) *The son of David* looks back to what Yahuah (the LORD) promised David, *I will set up thy seed after thee*, and *I will establish his kingdom*. The genealogy then shows that seed arriving as a real line of fathers and sons, all the way down to Yahusha (Jesus).
cards.prose: *The son of David* looks back to what Yahuah (the LORD) promised David, *I will set up thy seed after thee*, and *I will establish his kingdom*. The genealogy then shows that seed arriving as a real line of fathers and sons, all the way down to Yahusha (Jesus).
cards.member_note: 2 Samuel 7:12 — *I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.* Yahuah (the LORD) promises David a seed and an established kingdom, which Matthew's list traces to Yahusha (Jesus).

cards.src_text: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
cards.tgt_text: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
cards.old_note: The actual deportation of Yahudah (Judah) to Babylon — the historical anchor of Matthew's hinge.
cards.note: 2 Kings 24:14 — *And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.* *And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:* (Matthew 1:11) Matthew says the line came to Jechonias *about the time they were carried away to Babylon*, and Kings shows what that was. Jerusalem was emptied, and *none remained* but the poorest. The genealogy turns at this wound, and the line goes on in exile.
cards.prose: Matthew says the line came to Jechonias *about the time they were carried away to Babylon*, and Kings shows what that was. Jerusalem was emptied, and *none remained* but the poorest. The genealogy turns at this wound, and the line goes on in exile.
cards.member_note: 2 Kings 24:14 — *And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives.* Kings shows the carrying away to Babylon that Matthew marks, with Jerusalem emptied of its leaders and fighting men.

cards.src_text: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
cards.tgt_text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Yashar'el (Israel) away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
cards.old_note: The earlier Assyrian captivity of the northern house — the deportation Matthew implicitly carries because the northern house is still scattered when the genealogy reaches Yahusha (Jesus).
cards.note: 2 Kings 17:6 — *In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Yashar'el (Israel) away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.* *And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:* (Matthew 1:11) Long before Babylon, the king of Assyria *carried Yashar'el (Israel) away into Assyria*. Matthew's list passes through Babylon, but the northern house had already been scattered and had not come home. When the list reaches Yahusha (Jesus), the house of Yashar'el (Israel) is still waiting.
cards.prose: Long before Babylon, the king of Assyria *carried Yashar'el (Israel) away into Assyria*. Matthew's list passes through Babylon, but the northern house had already been scattered and had not come home. When the list reaches Yahusha (Jesus), the house of Yashar'el (Israel) is still waiting.
cards.member_note: 2 Kings 17:6 — *took Samaria, and carried Yashar'el (Israel) away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor.* The northern house of Yashar'el (Israel) was carried to Assyria well before Babylon and was still scattered when Matthew's list ends.

cards.src_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.tgt_text: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
cards.old_note: The seventy years of Babylonian captivity prophesied.
cards.note: Jeremiah 25:11 — *And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.* *So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.* (Matthew 1:17) Matthew counts fourteen generations from the carrying away to Messiah (Christ). Jeremiah had said how long Babylon would hold them, *seventy years*. The captivity was spoken ahead of time by the prophet, so Matthew counts it as part of the road and not as a break in it.
cards.prose: Matthew counts fourteen generations from the carrying away to Messiah (Christ). Jeremiah had said how long Babylon would hold them, *seventy years*. The captivity was spoken ahead of time by the prophet, so Matthew counts it as part of the road and not as a break in it.
cards.member_note: Jeremiah 25:11 — *And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.* Jeremiah foretold the length of the Babylonian captivity, so the carrying away is part of what was spoken beforehand.

cards.src_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.tgt_text: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
cards.old_note: The two-stick prophecy — the joining of the stick of Yahudah (Judah) and the stick of Yosef (Joseph)/Ephraim in the hand of the Messianic David. The Messiah of Matt 1 is the David of Ezek 37.
cards.note: Ezekiel 37:15 — *The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,* *So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.* (Matthew 1:17) Matthew counts the generations up to Messiah (Christ), and Ezekiel tells what Yahuah (the LORD) does with the two houses. They are written on two sticks and then joined, *And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.* (Ezekiel 37:17) The Messiah (Christ) the list ends with is the one in whose hand they are made one.
cards.prose: Matthew counts the generations up to Messiah (Christ), and Ezekiel tells what Yahuah (the LORD) does with the two houses. They are written on two sticks and then joined, *And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.* (Ezekiel 37:17) The Messiah (Christ) the list ends with is the one in whose hand they are made one.

cards.src_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.tgt_text: As I live, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
cards.old_note: The wilderness-of-the-peoples gathering — the post-scattering prophetic ingathering that the Messianic mission addresses.
cards.note: Ezekiel 20:33 — *As I live, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:* *So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.* (Matthew 1:17) The list ends with a people still scattered, and Ezekiel says how that ends. Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will rule over them *with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm*, and *I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered* (Ezekiel 20:34). That gathering is what the Messiah (Christ) is sent for.

cards.src_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.tgt_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
cards.old_note: *He shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth* — both houses, named, gathered.
cards.note: Isaiah 11:11 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.* *So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.* (Matthew 1:17) Matthew's three sets of fourteen end at Messiah (Christ), and Isaiah says what Yahuah (the LORD) does *the second time*, he sets his hand *to recover the remnant of his people*. The people the angel later says he will save are these scattered ones, called home from Assyria, Egypt, and the islands of the sea.

cards.member_note: Isaiah 11:11 — *Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people.* Yahuah (the LORD) sets his hand a second time to recover the remnant of his people from every place they were scattered.

cards.src_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.tgt_text: Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
cards.old_note: *Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head* — the one head Hosea names is the Messiah Matthew is genealogizing.
cards.note: Hosea 1:11 — *Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.* *So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.* (Matthew 1:17) Hosea says both houses are gathered and *appoint themselves one head*. Matthew's list is the account of that head, Messiah (Christ), coming down from Abraham through David. The two houses he is head over are the two houses named here, Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.prose: Hosea says both houses are gathered and *appoint themselves one head*. Matthew's list is the account of that head, Messiah (Christ), coming down from Abraham through David. The two houses he is head over are the two houses named here, Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.src_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.tgt_text: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), every one unto his city;
cards.old_note: The partial return from Babylon under Zerubbavel (Zerubbabel) — establishing that the post-exilic remnant in the land is not the prophetic ingathering.
cards.note: Ezra 2:1 — *Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), every one unto his city;* *So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.* (Matthew 1:17) Ezra lists the families that *went up out of the captivity*, and Matthew's third set of fourteen runs through that return as well. But it was a partial return to Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), and the gathering of both houses that the prophets spoke of was still ahead.

cards.member_note: Ezra 2:1 — *Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity.* Ezra lists the families that came back from Babylon, a return to Yahudah (Judah) that fell short of the prophets' ingathering.

cards.src_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.tgt_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
cards.old_note: *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us* — the Yochanan (John) parallel to the Matthean *Immanuel.*
cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* (Matthew 1:23) Matthew says *Elohim (God) with us*, and John says how it came about. *The Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us*. The Word who was with the fathers took a body, and that body is the child to be born of the virgin.
cards.prose: Matthew says *Elohim (God) with us*, and John says how it came about. *The Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us*. The Word who was with the fathers took a body, and that body is the child to be born of the virgin.
cards.member_note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us.* John says the Word became flesh and lived among us, which is how Elohim (God) is with us.

cards.src_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.tgt_text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
cards.old_note: *Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live* — the formless-infinite Father not seen by mortal eyes; the Formed in flesh is what is seen in Matt 1:23.
cards.note: Exodus 33:20 — *And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.* *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* (Matthew 1:23) Moses was told *there shall no man see me, and live*. The Father is the one nobody sees. So the one who is born, seen, held, and walked with, the *Elohim (God) with us* of Matthew, is Yahusha (Jesus), the Son who is seen and sent by the Father.
cards.prose: Moses was told *there shall no man see me, and live*. The Father is the one nobody sees. So the one who is born, seen, held, and walked with, the *Elohim (God) with us* of Matthew, is Yahusha (Jesus), the Son who is seen and sent by the Father.
cards.member_note: Exodus 33:20 — *And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.* Moses is told no man can see the Father and live, so the one who is seen is the Son.

cards.src_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.tgt_text: No man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
cards.old_note: *No man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son ... he hath declared him* — the Yochannine (Johannine) lock on Exodus 33:20.
cards.note: John 1:18 — *No man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.* *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* (Matthew 1:23) John states it flat, *No man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time*. The Father is unseen, and the Son *hath declared him*. So when Matthew says *Elohim (God) with us*, it is the Son who is seen and heard, making the Father known.

cards.src_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.tgt_text: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
cards.old_note: *Yahuah (the LORD) appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre ... and, lo, three men stood by him* — a theophany of the Formed in pre-incarnate form, prefiguring the Matt 1:23 incarnation.
cards.note: Genesis 18:1 — *And Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;* *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* (Matthew 1:23) *Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre*, and Abraham sat with the one who came. No man has seen the Father, so the one who appeared to Abraham is the Son, the same who is born of the virgin. He walked with the fathers before he was ever carried in Mary's womb.
cards.prose: *Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre*, and Abraham sat with the one who came. No man has seen the Father, so the one who appeared to Abraham is the Son, the same who is born of the virgin. He walked with the fathers before he was ever carried in Mary's womb.
cards.member_note: Genesis 18:1 — *And Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;* Yahuah (the LORD) appears to Abraham at Mamre, the Son who walked with the fathers long before Mary.

cards.src_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.tgt_text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel):
cards.old_note: *They saw the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) ... they saw Elohim (God), and did eat and drink* — the seventy elders see the Formed. The Formless is not what is seen; the Formed is.
cards.note: Exodus 24:9 — *Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel):* *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* (Matthew 1:23) Moses and the elders went up, and *they saw the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Exodus 24:10), and ate and drank. The Father is the one no man sees, so the one they saw was the Son. Matthew's *Elohim (God) with us* is the same one, now born into the flesh.
cards.prose: Moses and the elders went up, and *they saw the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Exodus 24:10), and ate and drank. The Father is the one no man sees, so the one they saw was the Son. Matthew's *Elohim (God) with us* is the same one, now born into the flesh.

cards.src_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.tgt_text: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that Elohim (God) may be all in all.
cards.old_note: *Then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him* — the eternal submission of the Formed to the Formless preserved in the eschaton. The Trinity's co-equal-persons frame cannot account for the eschatological submission; the framework's Formless-and-Formed reading carries it natively.
cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:28 — *And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that Elohim (God) may be all in all.* *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* (Matthew 1:23) Even at the end, *the Son also himself be subject*, under the one who put all things under him. The Son has a Father and stays under him. So *Elohim (God) with us* is the Father's presence made known in his Son, and not two equals standing side by side.
cards.prose: Even at the end, *the Son also himself be subject*, under the one who put all things under him. The Son has a Father and stays under him. So *Elohim (God) with us* is the Father's presence made known in his Son, and not two equals standing side by side.

cards.src_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.tgt_text: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is the Messiah (Christ); and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of the Messiah (Christ) is Elohim (God).
cards.old_note: *The head of the Messiah (Christ) is Elohim (God)* — the eternal headship of the Father over the Son, preserved through and after the incarnation.
cards.note: 1 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I would have you know, that the head of every man is the Messiah (Christ); and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of the Messiah (Christ) is Elohim (God).* *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* (Matthew 1:23) Matthew's *Elohim (God) with us* is the Son, and Paul says who stands over him, *the head of the Messiah (Christ) is Elohim (God)*. The Son is Elohim (God), and he has a Father. That headship did not end when he took flesh.
cards.prose: Matthew's *Elohim (God) with us* is the Son, and Paul says who stands over him, *the head of the Messiah (Christ) is Elohim (God)*. The Son is Elohim (God), and he has a Father. That headship did not end when he took flesh.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
cards.old_note: *And Mosheh (Moses) called Oshea (Hoshea) the son of Nun, Yahoshua (Joshua)* — the Old Testament parent-name to *Yahusha* is *Yahoshua* (the same root, the same divine-name component), and the renaming itself is theological.
cards.note: Numbers 13:16 — *These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) The name the angel gives is an old one. Moses gave it to Oshea the son of Nun, *Jehoshua*, which carries the Yah of Yahuah's (the LORD's) own name and says that he saves. The child is called by the same name for the same reason.
cards.prose: The name the angel gives is an old one. Moses gave it to Oshea the son of Nun, *Jehoshua*, which carries the Yah of Yahuah's (the LORD's) own name and says that he saves. The child is called by the same name for the same reason.
cards.member_note: Numbers 13:16 — *These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.* Moses renames Oshea Jehoshua, an older form of the name Yahusha (Jesus), with the Father's name inside it.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: Sing unto Elohim (God), sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
cards.old_note: *Sing unto Elohim (God), sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Yah, and rejoice before him* — the short form *Yah* preserved in the Old Testament as the explicit object of praise; the *Yah* in *Yahusha* is the name praised here.
cards.note: Psalm 68:4 — *Sing unto Elohim (God), sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) The psalm tells the singers to praise him *by his name JAH*, the short form of the name. That same Yah is the first part of Yahusha (Jesus), so the name the angel gives carries Yah in it and says what he has come to do.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,
cards.old_note: The commissioning of Yahoshua (Joshua) to lead the entry into the land — the first-fruits typology of the Messianic ingathering.
cards.note: Joshua 1:1 — *Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) After Moses died, Yahuah (the LORD) spoke to *Joshua the son of Nun* to lead the people into the land. He bears the same name as the child Joseph is told to call Yahusha (Jesus). The first one led the people in, and this one comes to bring the scattered home for good.
cards.prose: After Moses died, Yahuah (the LORD) spoke to *Joshua the son of Nun* to lead the people into the land. He bears the same name as the child Joseph is told to call Yahusha (Jesus). The first one led the people in, and this one comes to bring the scattered home for good.
cards.member_note: Joshua 1:1 — *Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,* Joshua, who bears the same name as Yahusha (Jesus), is commissioned to lead the people into the land.

cards.src_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.tgt_text: Wherefore Elohim (God) also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

cards.note: Philippians 2:9 — *Wherefore Elohim (God) also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:* *And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.* (Matthew 1:21) The angel gives the name, and Paul says where it ends up, *a name which is above every name*. The name Yahusha (Jesus) was given at the birth to say that Yahuah (the LORD) saves, and Elohim (God) raised the one who carries it to the highest place.

cards.src_text: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
cards.tgt_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Yashar'el (Israel)? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.
cards.old_note: The anointing of David — the founding moment of the kingship-line the genealogy traces.
cards.note: 1 Samuel 16:1 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Yashar'el (Israel)? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.* *And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;* (Matthew 1:6) Matthew writes *Jesse begat David the king*, and here is how that came about. Yahuah (the LORD) sends Samuel to Jesse because *I have provided me a king among his sons*. The king did not rise by his own reaching. He was provided, and the line to Yahusha (Jesus) runs through him.
cards.prose: Matthew writes *Jesse begat David the king*, and here is how that came about. Yahuah (the LORD) sends Samuel to Jesse because *I have provided me a king among his sons*. The king did not rise by his own reaching. He was provided, and the line to Yahusha (Jesus) runs through him.
cards.member_note: 1 Samuel 16:1 — *fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.* Yahuah (the LORD) sends Samuel to anoint a king from among Jesse's sons, the founding of the king's line.

cards.src_text: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
cards.tgt_text: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Yashar'el (Israel); and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.
cards.old_note: The David-Bathsheba-Uriah narrative — the source of Matthew's naming-by-Uriah construction.
cards.note: 2 Samuel 11:1 — *And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Yashar'el (Israel); and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.* *And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;* (Matthew 1:6) Matthew says Solomon came from the wife of Urias, and this is where it began. The army was out at war, and *But David tarried still at Jerusalem*. Matthew's list does not hide how Solomon came to be.

cards.member_note: 2 Samuel 11:1 — *But David tarried still at Jerusalem.* The account of David and Bath-sheba begins with the king staying home while the army fights, which is the root of Matthew's phrase.

cards.src_text: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
cards.tgt_text: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
cards.old_note: Yo'achaz (Jehoahaz) deposed by Pharaoh — the kings between Josias (Yoshiyahu) and the deportation, the unstable monarchy collapsing toward the captivity.
cards.note: 2 Kings 23:34 — *And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.* *And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:* (Matthew 1:11) Josias is the last king Matthew names before the carrying away, and Kings shows what followed him. Pharaoh Nechoh put Eliakim on the throne and *turned his name to Jehoiakim*, and carried Jehoahaz off to Egypt. Kings were being set and removed by foreign hands before Babylon ever came.

cards.src_text: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
cards.tgt_text: As I live, saith Yahuah (LORD), though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
cards.old_note: Yahuah-pronouncement against Konyahu (Jeconiah) — *no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David* — addressed in framework reading through Yoseph's (Joseph's) legal adoption of Yahusha (Jesus), bypassing the Jeconiah-blood-curse while preserving the legal-Davidic claim.
cards.note: Jeremiah 22:24 — *As I live, saith Yahuah (LORD), though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;* *And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:* (Matthew 1:11) Matthew's *Jechonias* is the Coniah of Jeremiah, and Yahuah (the LORD) says that even if he *were the signet upon my right hand*, he would pluck him off. Matthew still lets the line run through him, and then tells that the child was conceived of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
cards.prose: Matthew's *Jechonias* is the Coniah of Jeremiah, and Yahuah (the LORD) says that even if he *were the signet upon my right hand*, he would pluck him off. Matthew still lets the line run through him, and then tells that the child was conceived of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).

cards.src_text: Now the birth of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
cards.tgt_text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from Elohim (God) unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
cards.old_note: The annunciation to Miryam (Mary) — the parallel narrative of the Spirit-conception.
cards.note: Luke 1:26 — *And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from Elohim (God) unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,* *Now the birth of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).* (Matthew 1:18) Matthew tells the conception from Joseph's side and Luke tells it from Mary's, beginning where *the angel Gabriel was sent from Elohim (God)* to Nazareth. It is one event told from two doorways, and the two accounts agree on whose child this is.

cards.member_note: Luke 1:26 — *And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from Elohim (God) unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,* Luke begins the same conception from Mary's side, with Gabriel sent to Nazareth.

cards.src_text: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
cards.tgt_text: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie with her;
cards.old_note: The Torah's penalty provision for adultery in an espoused virgin — the legal exposure Yoseph's (Joseph's) quiet divorce would have shielded Miryam (Mary) from.
cards.note: Deuteronomy 22:23 — *If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie with her;* *Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.* (Matthew 1:19) Joseph knew what the Torah says where *a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed* and is found with another man. Being a just man he was not willing to make her a public example, and the Torah itself gave him the quiet road he chose.

cards.member_note: Deuteronomy 22:23 — *If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie with her;* The Torah speaks of a betrothed virgin found with another man, the exposure Joseph's quiet course would have spared Mary.

cards.src_text: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
cards.tgt_text: When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, and give it in her hand, and send her out of his house.
cards.old_note: The bill of divorcement provision — Yoseph's (Joseph's) Torah-righteous response operates within this framework.
cards.note: Deuteronomy 24:1 — *When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, and give it in her hand, and send her out of his house.* *Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.* (Matthew 1:19) The Torah lets a man give *a bill of divorcement* into her hand. Matthew says Joseph was *minded to put her away privily*, which means a written paper and no public trial. He stayed inside the Torah and spared her.

cards.src_text: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
cards.tgt_text: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending on it.
cards.old_note: Ya'aqov's (Jacob's) dream at Beth-el — the angel-in-a-dream as the Tanakh-pattern divine-instruction medium.
cards.note: Genesis 28:12 — *And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending on it.* *But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).* (Matthew 1:20) Elohim (God) spoke to Jacob in a dream, with angels going up and down, and now the angel of Yahuah (the LORD) speaks to Joseph *in a dream*. It is the same way he guides his own. Jacob's dream carried the promise to his seed, and Joseph's carries it to the child.
cards.prose: Elohim (God) spoke to Jacob in a dream, with angels going up and down, and now the angel of Yahuah (the LORD) speaks to Joseph *in a dream*. It is the same way he guides his own. Jacob's dream carried the promise to his seed, and Joseph's carries it to the child.

cards.src_text: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
cards.tgt_text: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
cards.old_note: The patriarch Yoseph's (Joseph's) own dreams — Matthew's Yoseph (Joseph) carries the Tanakh-Yoseph's (Joseph's) dream-receiving role.
cards.note: Genesis 37:5 — *And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.* *But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).* (Matthew 1:20) The first Joseph was a dreamer, and *Joseph dreamed a dream* that steered the course of his father's whole house. This Joseph is given word in a dream too, and before the story is far along he also goes down into Egypt with the seed of promise in his keeping.

cards.tgt_text: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the Elohim (God) of heaven.

Then Daniel blessed the Elohim (God) of heaven.* *But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).* (Matthew 1:20) *Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision*. Yahuah (the LORD) has often opened hidden things to his servants by night, and Joseph's dream is of that kind. The hidden thing, how the child was conceived, is opened to him by an angel.
cards.prose: *Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision*. Yahuah (the LORD) has often opened hidden things to his servants by night, and Joseph's dream is of that kind. The hidden thing, how the child was conceived, is opened to him by an angel.

cards.src_text: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
cards.tgt_text: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
cards.old_note: *Thou son of David* invokes the Davidic-covenant promise the angel is now naming Yoseph (Joseph) as the carrier of.
cards.note: 2 Samuel 7:12 — *And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.* *But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).* (Matthew 1:20) The angel calls him *thou son of David*, and those words point to what Yahuah (the LORD) promised David, *I will set up thy seed after thee*. Joseph is the man through whom David's house is handed to the child, as he takes Mary and names him.
cards.prose: The angel calls him *thou son of David*, and those words point to what Yahuah (the LORD) promised David, *I will set up thy seed after thee*. Joseph is the man through whom David's house is handed to the child, as he takes Mary and names him.
cards.member_note: 2 Samuel 7:12 — *I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.* The angel's name for Joseph, son of David, points to the promise of a seed and a kingdom.

cards.src_text: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of Yahuah (Lord) had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
cards.tgt_text: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
cards.old_note: *And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes* — Luke's parallel of the firstborn naming.
cards.note: Luke 2:7 — *And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.* *Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of Yahuah (Lord) had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:* (Matthew 1:24) Joseph did as he was told and took his wife, and Luke tells what followed, that she bore *her firstborn son* and wrapped him in swaddling clothes. Matthew goes on to say Joseph named him Yahusha (Jesus). The birth Luke describes is the birth Joseph's obedience made room for.
cards.prose: Joseph did as he was told and took his wife, and Luke tells what followed, that she bore *her firstborn son* and wrapped him in swaddling clothes. Matthew goes on to say Joseph named him Yahusha (Jesus). The birth Luke describes is the birth Joseph's obedience made room for.
