It is the old northern ground where the scattered house was carried off, and the light the prophet goes on to promise rises there first.
cards.member_note: Isaiah 9:1 — *Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.* Isaiah names Zebulun and Naphtali, Galilee, as the first land afflicted, the northern country where the light is promised next.

cards.src_text: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
cards.tgt_text: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of Yahuah (LORD):
cards.old_note: The Tanakh's closing prophecy of Eliyahu (Elijah) sent before the great and dreadful day of Yahuah (the LORD) — the prophetic source Yochanan (John) embodies.
cards.note: Malachi 4:5 — *Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of Yahuah (LORD):* *In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,* (Matthew 3:1) The last page of the prophets already said who would come before the great day of Yahuah (the LORD): *Elijah the prophet*. Right after it, Yahuah (the LORD) tells them to remember the law of Moses, so the one he sends comes to turn hearts back to the fathers and the Torah. John preaching in the wilderness is that sending.
cards.prose: The last page of the prophets already said who would come before the great day of Yahuah (the LORD): *Elijah the prophet*. Right after it, Yahuah (the LORD) tells them to remember the law of Moses, so the one he sends comes to turn hearts back to the fathers and the Torah. John preaching in the wilderness is that sending.
cards.member_note: Malachi 4:5 — *Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of Yahuah (LORD):* The closing word of the prophets promises Elijah before the great day of Yahuah (the LORD), and John arrives in the wilderness as that promise.

cards.src_text: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
cards.tgt_text: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
cards.old_note: Eliyahu (Elijah) at Mount Carmel confronting the Ba'al-system — the Tanakh-pattern of the wilderness-prophet calling the covenant people to choose.
cards.note: 1 Kings 18:1 — *And it came to pass after many days, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.* *In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,* (Matthew 3:1) Elijah was a prophet sent by the word of Yahuah (the LORD) to meet the king while the land was starving, and from there he put the whole people to the choice between Yahuah (the LORD) and Baal. John comes the same way, out of the wilderness to a covenant people with one demand, that they turn.
cards.prose: Elijah was a prophet sent by the word of Yahuah (the LORD) to meet the king while the land was starving, and from there he put the whole people to the choice between Yahuah (the LORD) and Baal. John comes the same way, out of the wilderness to a covenant people with one demand, that they turn.
cards.member_note: 1 Kings 18:1 — *the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Elijah in the third year.* Elijah is sent by the word of Yahuah (the LORD) to confront a king and call a people back, the pattern John follows.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), every one according to his ways, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD). Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
cards.old_note: The prophetic-*teshuvah* call — *turn yourselves from all your transgressions ... cast away from you all your transgressions ... and make you a new heart* — the kind of repentance Yochanan (John) is calling for, not Reformation-style justification-by-faith-alone repentance.
cards.note: Ezekiel 18:30 — *Therefore I will judge you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), every one according to his ways, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD). Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) John asks the Pharisees and Sadducees who warned them to flee, and then tells them to bring forth fruit. Yahuah (the LORD) said the same to the house of Yashar'el (Israel) in Ezekiel, judging *every one according to his ways*, and the way out is to turn from all the transgressions. Repentance here is a changed life, and nothing less.
cards.prose: John asks the Pharisees and Sadducees who warned them to flee, and then tells them to bring forth fruit. Yahuah (the LORD) said the same to the house of Yashar'el (Israel) in Ezekiel, judging *every one according to his ways*, and the way out is to turn from all the transgressions. Repentance here is a changed life, and nothing less.
cards.member_note: Ezekiel 18:30 — *Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions.* Yahuah (the LORD) calls the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to turn from all its transgressions, the same turning of a whole life John asks for.

cards.src_text: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
cards.tgt_text: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of Yahuah (LORD), make straight in the desert a highway for our Elohim (God).
cards.old_note: The wilderness-voice preparing the way; opens Yeshayahu's (Isaiah's) gathering-and-return prophecies.
cards.note: Isaiah 40:3 — *The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of Yahuah (LORD), make straight in the desert a highway for our Elohim (God).* *In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,* (Matthew 3:1) Isaiah's chapter opens with *Comfort ye, comfort ye my people* (Isaiah 40:1), her iniquity pardoned, and then comes a voice in the wilderness clearing the road for the coming of Yahuah (the LORD) himself. Matthew puts John in the wilderness as that voice, at the front edge of the return Isaiah goes on to describe.
cards.prose: Isaiah's chapter opens with *Comfort ye, comfort ye my people* (Isaiah 40:1), her iniquity pardoned, and then comes a voice in the wilderness clearing the road for the coming of Yahuah (the LORD) himself. Matthew puts John in the wilderness as that voice, at the front edge of the return Isaiah goes on to describe.
cards.member_note: Isaiah 40:3 — *Prepare ye the way of Yahuah (LORD), make straight in the desert a highway.* Isaiah's voice in the wilderness clears the road for Yahuah (the LORD) at the head of his comfort to his people, and John is that voice.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
cards.old_note: Yahusha's (Jesus's) own *Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers* identification of the scribes and Pharisees — the same diagnostic Yochanan (John) named first.
cards.note: Matthew 23:33 — *Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) John called them a *generation of vipers* and asked who had warned them to flee. Yahusha (Jesus) says it again to the scribes and Pharisees in the temple, with the blood of the prophets spread out before them. It is the same word aimed at a system and the seed behind it, and John's own question still leaves the door open to any who turn.
cards.prose: John called them a *generation of vipers* and asked who had warned them to flee. Yahusha (Jesus) says it again to the scribes and Pharisees in the temple, with the blood of the prophets spread out before them. It is the same word aimed at a system and the seed behind it, and John's own question still leaves the door open to any who turn.
cards.member_note: Matthew 23:33 — *Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?* Yahusha (Jesus) later gives the scribes and Pharisees the same name John gave them at the Jordan, so the word was never a passing outburst.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
cards.old_note: *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do* — the seed-war identification of the leadership-system.
cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) John's *generation of vipers* and Yahusha's (Jesus's) *of your father the devil* name the same thing, a seed that does its father's work, a liar and a murderer from the beginning. He says it to men who *cannot hear my word* (John 8:43), so it is aimed at the system and its seed, never at the people as a whole.
cards.prose: John's *generation of vipers* and Yahusha's (Jesus's) *of your father the devil* name the same thing, a seed that does its father's work, a liar and a murderer from the beginning. He says it to men who *cannot hear my word* (John 8:43), so it is aimed at the system and its seed, never at the people as a whole.
cards.member_note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do.* Yahusha (Jesus) names whose seed it is that does the father's work, which is what John saw coming to the water as vipers.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
cards.old_note: The Tanakh-source of the serpent-seed-vs-woman-seed enmity that the *vipers* identification draws on.
cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) Behind the word vipers is the first enmity, spoken by Yahuah (the LORD) to the serpent in the garden, *thy seed and her seed*. When John turns on the men coming to the river, he is saying which side of that line their fruit shows them on, and his talk of trees and chaff in the same chapter is about the same sorting.
cards.prose: Behind the word vipers is the first enmity, spoken by Yahuah (the LORD) to the serpent in the garden, *thy seed and her seed*. When John turns on the men coming to the river, he is saying which side of that line their fruit shows them on, and his talk of trees and chaff in the same chapter is about the same sorting.
cards.member_note: Genesis 3:15 — *between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed.* Yahuah (the LORD) set enmity between the serpent's seed and the woman's seed, the line John's word vipers falls along.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: And certain men which came down from Judæa taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
cards.old_note: The first-century Judaizer-party — *certain men which came down from Yahudah (Judaea)* and the believing Pharisees demanding circumcision of Gentile believers — the apostolic-era continuation of the same system.
cards.note: Acts 15:1 — *And certain men which came down from Judæa taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) The men who came down from Judaea made a mark in the flesh the door of salvation, saying that without it *ye cannot be saved*. That is the same shelter John tears away when he tells the Pharisees not to say they have Abraham for their father. John asks for fruit, and these men pointed to a credential.
cards.prose: The men who came down from Judaea made a mark in the flesh the door of salvation, saying that without it *ye cannot be saved*. That is the same shelter John tears away when he tells the Pharisees not to say they have Abraham for their father. John asks for fruit, and these men pointed to a credential.
cards.member_note: Acts 15:1 — *Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.* Men teaching that a rite makes a man saved are the same flesh credential John would not let the Pharisees hide behind.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), that they might bring us into bondage:
cards.old_note: *False brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Messiah (Christ) Yahusha (Jesus), that they might bring us into bondage* — Paul naming the Judaizer-pattern by the same diagnostic.
cards.note: Galatians 2:4 — *And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), that they might bring us into bondage:* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) Paul calls them *false brethren*, brought in quietly to spy and to put a man's standing under a mark of the flesh, and he gave them place *no, not for an hour* (Galatians 2:5). John saw the same sort coming to the water and refused them the same shelter. The bondage here is a flesh credential laid over the covenant, not the commandments.
cards.prose: Paul calls them *false brethren*, brought in quietly to spy and to put a man's standing under a mark of the flesh, and he gave them place *no, not for an hour* (Galatians 2:5). John saw the same sort coming to the water and refused them the same shelter. The bondage here is a flesh credential laid over the covenant, not the commandments.
cards.member_note: Galatians 2:4 — *false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty.* Paul names the men who slipped in to bind others with a flesh credential, the same system John met at the Jordan.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
cards.old_note: *Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision* — Paul's denunciation of the circumcision-party using language structurally parallel to Yochanan's (John's) *vipers.*
cards.note: Philippians 3:2 — *Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) Paul warns against those who trust in the flesh, and in the verses after it he lists his own credentials, circumcised, of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel), *as touching the law, a Pharisee* (Philippians 3:5). These are the very things John says no one may stand behind. The warning is aimed at a teaching, and Paul himself is a Pharisee who turned.
cards.prose: Paul warns against those who trust in the flesh, and in the verses after it he lists his own credentials, circumcised, of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel), *as touching the law, a Pharisee* (Philippians 3:5). These are the very things John says no one may stand behind. The warning is aimed at a teaching, and Paul himself is a Pharisee who turned.
cards.member_note: Philippians 3:2 — *Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.* Paul warns against confidence in the flesh and then sets out his own credentials, which are what John says cannot shelter anyone.

cards.src_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
cards.tgt_text: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Yahudim (Jews):
cards.old_note: Nicodemus the Pharisee coming to Yahusha (Jesus) by night — the individual Pharisee who turns, the framework's victim-not-enemy posture applied.
cards.note: John 3:1 — *There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Yahudim (Jews):* *But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?* (Matthew 3:7) Not every Pharisee who came stayed what John saw at the river. Here is one of the same sect, a ruler of the Yahudim (Jews), coming to Yahusha (Jesus) with his questions. John's word was aimed at the system that made them what they were, and a man standing in it can still turn and come.
cards.prose: Not every Pharisee who came stayed what John saw at the river. Here is one of the same sect, a ruler of the Yahudim (Jews), coming to Yahusha (Jesus) with his questions. John's word was aimed at the system that made them what they were, and a man standing in it can still turn and come.
cards.member_note: John 3:1 — *There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Yahudim (Jews):* Nicodemus, a Pharisee and a ruler, comes to Yahusha (Jesus) himself, so a man standing inside that system can still turn and come.

cards.src_text: Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
cards.tgt_text: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
cards.old_note: The Yarden (Jordan)-crossing under Yahoshua (Joshua) — the Tanakh-pattern the Matt 3 immersion recapitulates.
cards.note: Joshua 3:14 — *And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;* *Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.* (Matthew 3:13) The people first went over this river behind *the ark of the covenant*, out of the wilderness and into the land promised them. Matthew brings Yahusha (Jesus) to the same water just as John is calling the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to turn, so the Jordan is where the way home is walked again.
cards.prose: The people first went over this river behind *the ark of the covenant*, out of the wilderness and into the land promised them. Matthew brings Yahusha (Jesus) to the same water just as John is calling the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to turn, so the Jordan is where the way home is walked again.
cards.member_note: Joshua 3:14 — *the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people.* Yashar'el (Israel) first crossed the Jordan behind the ark, the crossing into the land that Yahusha (Jesus) meets again at the same water.

cards.src_text: Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
cards.tgt_text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,
cards.old_note: The commissioning of Yahoshua (Joshua) to lead the entry — the first-leader pattern.
cards.note: Joshua 1:1 — *Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,* *Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.* (Matthew 3:13) Yahuah (the LORD) told Joshua to *go over this Jordan* (Joshua 1:2), taking all the people into the land after Moses had died. Joshua bears the very name Yahusha (Jesus) does, and Matthew sets Yahusha (Jesus) at that river to begin his work.
cards.prose: Yahuah (the LORD) told Joshua to *go over this Jordan* (Joshua 1:2), taking all the people into the land after Moses had died. Joshua bears the very name Yahusha (Jesus) does, and Matthew sets Yahusha (Jesus) at that river to begin his work.
cards.member_note: Joshua 1:1 — *Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun.* Joshua is commissioned to lead the people over the Jordan into the land, and Yahusha (Jesus), who has the same name, stands at the same river.

cards.src_text: Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
cards.tgt_text: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for Yahuah (LORD) hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As Yahuah (LORD) liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.
cards.old_note: Eliyahu (Elijah) and Elisha at the Yarden (Jordan) — the prophetic-mantle-transfer at the same river; the framework reads the gospel's choice of Yarden (Jordan) as deliberately echoing this prophetic-action history.
cards.note: 2 Kings 2:6 — *And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for Yahuah (LORD) hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As Yahuah (LORD) liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.* *Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.* (Matthew 3:13) Yahuah (the LORD) sent Elijah to the Jordan, and Elisha would not leave him, asking at that river for *a double portion of thy spirit* (2 Kings 2:9). Matthew sets John, the Elijah who was to come, at the same water, and the one who comes up out of it is the one the Spirit rests on.
cards.prose: Yahuah (the LORD) sent Elijah to the Jordan, and Elisha would not leave him, asking at that river for *a double portion of thy spirit* (2 Kings 2:9). Matthew sets John, the Elijah who was to come, at the same water, and the one who comes up out of it is the one the Spirit rests on.
cards.member_note: 2 Kings 2:6 — *Yahuah (LORD) hath sent me to Jordan.* Elijah is sent to the Jordan and Elisha will not leave him there, the prophet's errand at the river that John's work at the Jordan repeats.

cards.src_text: Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
cards.tgt_text: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of Elohim (God): and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
cards.old_note: Na'aman (Naaman) the Syrian dipping seven times in the Yarden (Jordan) and being cleansed — the Yarden (Jordan) as the river of prophetic-action cleansing.
cards.note: 2 Kings 5:14 — *Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of Elohim (God): and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.* *Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.* (Matthew 3:13) Naaman went down into the Jordan at the word of the prophet, *according to the saying of the man of Elohim (God)*, and came up clean. The river already carried cleansing at a prophet's word. John baptizes there with the people confessing their sins, and Yahusha (Jesus) comes down to the same water.
cards.prose: Naaman went down into the Jordan at the word of the prophet, *according to the saying of the man of Elohim (God)*, and came up clean. The river already carried cleansing at a prophet's word. John baptizes there with the people confessing their sins, and Yahusha (Jesus) comes down to the same water.
cards.member_note: 2 Kings 5:14 — *dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of Elohim (God).* Naaman is made clean in the Jordan at a prophet's word, showing the river as a place of cleansing before John baptized there.

cards.src_text: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), and with fire:
cards.tgt_text: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and Yahuah (Lord), whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
cards.old_note: *Who may abide the day of his coming? ... for he is like a refiner's fire* — the fire-baptism Yochanan (John) names is Malachi's refiner's fire; the sifting that the gathering carries.
cards.note: Malachi 3:1 — *Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and Yahuah (Lord), whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* *I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), and with fire:* (Matthew 3:11) John says the coming one brings both the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) and fire, and Malachi says what that fire is. The one the people seek is to come to his temple without warning, and no one can be sure of standing in that day. He is a refiner of silver, working on the sons of Levi until what is offered is righteous, so the fire is a sifting and not mere ruin.
cards.prose: John says the coming one brings both the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) and fire, and Malachi says what that fire is. The one the people seek is to come to his temple without warning, and no one can be sure of standing in that day. He is a refiner of silver, working on the sons of Levi until what is offered is righteous, so the fire is a sifting and not mere ruin.
cards.member_note: Malachi 3:1 — *he shall come, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* Malachi's refiner's fire, the day of his coming and who can stand it, is the fire John says the coming one brings.

cards.src_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becomes us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
cards.tgt_text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
cards.old_note: *By his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many* — the Servant-Song's *righteous* anticipation of the Messiah's righteousness, into which the immersion is the public entry.
cards.note: Isaiah 53:11 — *He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.* *And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becomes us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.* (Matthew 3:15) Yahusha (Jesus) says it becomes him and John to fulfil all righteousness, and Isaiah calls the one who comes *my righteous servant*, who bears the iniquities of many. The people confessed their sins at the water and he had none to confess, so he stands there already taking up the servant's work.
cards.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) says it becomes him and John to fulfil all righteousness, and Isaiah calls the one who comes *my righteous servant*, who bears the iniquities of many. The people confessed their sins at the water and he had none to confess, so he stands there already taking up the servant's work.
cards.member_note: Isaiah 53:11 — *by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many.* The servant of Yahuah (the LORD) is called righteous and bears the iniquities of many, the work Yahusha (Jesus) takes up when he is baptized.

cards.src_text: Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,
cards.tgt_text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
cards.old_note: The verse the devil quoted, with the qualifier *to keep thee in all thy ways* (v.11) omitted in the devil's citation.
cards.note: Psalm 91:11 — *For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.* *Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,* (Matthew 4:5) Look at what the devil left off when he quoted this at the pinnacle. The promise is that the angels keep him *in all thy ways*, and a leap from the temple roof is nobody's way. It is a dare. Yahusha (Jesus) walks in the ways of Yahuah (the LORD), and he will not put the Father to the proof.
cards.prose: Look at what the devil left off when he quoted this at the pinnacle. The promise is that the angels keep him *in all thy ways*, and a leap from the temple roof is nobody's way. It is a dare. Yahusha (Jesus) walks in the ways of Yahuah (the LORD), and he will not put the Father to the proof.
cards.member_note: Psalm 91:11 — *For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.* The psalm promises angels will keep him in all his ways, which the devil's quotation of it passes over.

cards.src_text: Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,
cards.tgt_text: Ye shall not tempt Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as ye tempted him in Massah.
cards.old_note: The OVERRIDING Torah-word Yahusha (Jesus) brought into the conversation — the canon-harmonized response.
cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:16 — *Ye shall not tempt Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as ye tempted him in Massah.* *Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,* (Matthew 4:5) The tempter reached for the psalm, and Yahusha (Jesus) answers from the Torah, as he does all three times in the wilderness. Moses had already named the place where Yashar'el (Israel) put Yahuah (the LORD) to the test, *as ye tempted him in Massah*, and the Son will not do it again. The commandment stands, and the one who gave it keeps it.
cards.prose: The tempter reached for the psalm, and Yahusha (Jesus) answers from the Torah, as he does all three times in the wilderness. Moses had already named the place where Yashar'el (Israel) put Yahuah (the LORD) to the test, *as ye tempted him in Massah*, and the Son will not do it again. The commandment stands, and the one who gave it keeps it.
cards.member_note: Deuteronomy 6:16 — *Ye shall not tempt Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as ye tempted him in Massah.* Moses forbids putting Yahuah (the LORD) to the test as Yashar'el (Israel) did at Massah, and Yahusha (Jesus) answers the pinnacle with it.

cards.src_text: Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,
cards.tgt_text: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
cards.old_note: *He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar* — the 1234-of-Truth filter that rules out any scripture-reading that voids the commandments; the meta-test that disqualifies the devil's Psalm-91 misuse and every parallel misuse.
cards.note: 1 John 2:3 — *And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.* *Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,* (Matthew 4:5) The devil's way of reading the psalm would have Yahusha (Jesus) break a commandment to cash in a promise. John gives the plain test that catches it: knowing him shows in keeping *his commandments*, so any use of scripture that sets a commandment aside is not knowing him at all. Yahusha (Jesus) keeps the commandment, and the promise is left standing where the psalm put it.
cards.prose: The devil's way of reading the psalm would have Yahusha (Jesus) break a commandment to cash in a promise. John gives the plain test that catches it: knowing him shows in keeping *his commandments*, so any use of scripture that sets a commandment aside is not knowing him at all. Yahusha (Jesus) keeps the commandment, and the promise is left standing where the psalm put it.
cards.member_note: 1 John 2:3 — *And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.* John says we know him by keeping his commandments, which rules out any reading of scripture that sets them aside.

cards.src_text: Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,
cards.tgt_text: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of Elohim (God).
cards.old_note: *Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of Elohim (God)* — Yahusha (Jesus) naming the Sadducees' selective-scripture reading as the source of their error; the same diagnostic.
cards.note: Matthew 22:29 — *Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of Elohim (God).* *Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,* (Matthew 4:5) The devil quoted a true word and left out what stood beside it. Yahusha (Jesus) told the Sadducees they erred *not knowing the scriptures*, and that is the same fault seen from the other side. To know the scriptures is to know them whole, with the word that sits next to the one you quote, and on the pinnacle he sets the Torah beside the psalm.
cards.prose: The devil quoted a true word and left out what stood beside it. Yahusha (Jesus) told the Sadducees they erred *not knowing the scriptures*, and that is the same fault seen from the other side. To know the scriptures is to know them whole, with the word that sits next to the one you quote, and on the pinnacle he sets the Torah beside the psalm.
cards.member_note: Matthew 22:29 — *Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of Elohim (God).* Yahusha (Jesus) tells the Sadducees their error comes from not knowing the scriptures, the same fault the devil trades on at the pinnacle.

cards.src_text: Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,
cards.tgt_text: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
cards.old_note: *Some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction* — the apostolic naming of the scripture-twisting pattern.
cards.note: 2 Peter 3:16 — *As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.* *Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,* (Matthew 4:5) Peter says the unlearned and unstable *wrest* the scriptures to their own ruin, and the devil at the pinnacle is the first to do it, lifting a true word out of its place and bending it into a dare. The same twisting has been done to Paul's letters since, and the answer is the one given in the wilderness: read it beside what Yahuah (the LORD) already said.
cards.prose: Peter says the unlearned and unstable *wrest* the scriptures to their own ruin, and the devil at the pinnacle is the first to do it, lifting a true word out of its place and bending it into a dare. The same twisting has been done to Paul's letters since, and the answer is the one given in the wilderness: read it beside what Yahuah (the LORD) already said.
cards.member_note: 2 Peter 3:16 — *unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.* Peter names the wresting of scripture that the devil begins at the pinnacle and that was later turned on Paul's letters.

cards.src_text: Again, the devil takes him up into an exceeding high mountain, and shows him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
cards.tgt_text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
cards.old_note: The prince of Persia, the prince of Grecia — the principalities administering the world's kingdoms in Daniel's vision.
cards.note: Daniel 10:13 — *But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.* *Again, the devil takes him up into an exceeding high mountain, and shows him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;* (Matthew 4:8) Daniel is told of a prince standing behind the kingdom of Persia who held a messenger back *one and twenty days* until Michael came to help. Powers sit behind the kingdoms of the world, and that is what the devil is holding out on the mountain. He is offering what he administers, and Yahusha (Jesus) will not buy it.
cards.prose: Daniel is told of a prince standing behind the kingdom of Persia who held a messenger back *one and twenty days* until Michael came to help. Powers sit behind the kingdoms of the world, and that is what the devil is holding out on the mountain. He is offering what he administers, and Yahusha (Jesus) will not buy it.
cards.member_note: Daniel 10:13 — *But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days.* A prince stands behind the kingdom of Persia and resists the messenger, showing that powers sit behind the kingdoms of the world.

cards.src_text: Again, the devil takes him up into an exceeding high mountain, and shows him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
cards.tgt_text: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
cards.old_note: The prince of Persia, the prince of Grecia — the principalities administering the world's kingdoms in Daniel's vision.
cards.note: Daniel 10:20 — *Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.* *Again, the devil takes him up into an exceeding high mountain, and shows him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;* (Matthew 4:8) The messenger goes on to name the next one, the prince of Grecia, so the powers over the kingdoms come in a line as the kingdoms rise. The devil's sweep across all the kingdoms of the world takes in that whole line. What he shows is real, and the price of it is worship, which is the one thing Yahusha (Jesus) will not pay.

The devil's sweep across all the kingdoms of the world takes in that whole line. What he shows is real, and the price of it is worship, which is the one thing Yahusha (Jesus) will not pay.
